claims.text: The log carries every one of the 94, exactly once, as the standings record states them: every strict-core reading in the executed standings (the WS2 relabel execution record: 5 E + 65 I + 4 R + 3 P + 17 U) appears exactly once in the inference log, with its sign, its reading as recorded, its executed class, and its source-diversity flag as that record states them. This does not establish: that the standings are correct; the log transcribes the record of record, it does not re-derive it.

falsification_tests: A sign in the standings record absent from the log or present twice; a log entry whose reading, class, or flag differs from the standings record's row for that sign.

claims.text: Every item is typed by the filed basis, and ambiguity is recorded, never resolved silently: each item is typed (a) primary evidence, (b) another reading or a candidate-system construct used as evidence, or ambiguous, under the typing rules of spec section 3.3; every (b) item names the readings it depends on, or records that the basis names no target; every (b) and ambiguous item carries a reason tied to the basis text; and every (b) classification was verified by reading the filed basis clause it cites. This does not establish: that a (b) typing makes an item worthless; it makes the item dependent, which is what the audit measures; several (b) items record real co-occurrence whose raw counts the log also carries as (a) items.

evidence.description: Spec section 3.3 (item kinds and typing rules) and section 3.4 (ambiguity rule).

falsification_tests: A (b) item whose cited basis clause, read plainly, states primary evidence and no other reading or construct; an ambiguous item with no reason; a named target absent from the cited clause and from the records the spec names as the item's source.

claims.text: The audit applies the adjudication's class rules and moves nothing: each reading's outcome is stated in the vocabulary of spec section 4.2 (class unchanged / basis weakened with the losses named / class would change with the destination named), computed under the relabel execution record's class definitions and the reclassification form of its addendum; both the primary treatment (ambiguous retained) and the sensitivity treatment (ambiguous removed) are computed and any divergence reported; and no standing, anchor, or register entry is altered by the audit or by any record of this package.
